_comment: Knowledge for SunCraft Roofing - built from suncraftroofing.com on 2026-11-08 for the TMN Creative partner demo. Pricing is not published on the site (a $$ range only) and hours aren't published either, so this demo says so instead of quoting either.

booking.instructions: Book a roof inspection right here in chat (leave your name, email and a note about your roof), or call 310-955-1051.

demo_chips: Can you inspect my roof before quoting?
fallback: Great question - I don't want to guess on that one. You can call SunCraft Roofing at 310-955-1051, email info@suncraftroofing.com, or leave your name and email here and the team will follow up.

faqs.q: What roofing services do you offer?
faqs.a: Inspections, repairs, replacements, maintenance and emergency repairs for homes and commercial buildings - including shingle, tile, metal and flat roof systems (TPO, PVC, torch down and coatings).

Yes - SunCraft Roofing is licensed, insured and bonded (California CSLB license #1146573), and is an APOC Certified Contractor and a GAF Certified Plus Roofing Contractor. Owner Garrett Horton personally conducts inspections.

faqs.q: How much does a new roof cost?
faqs.a: Pricing isn't published on the SunCraft website - every job starts with a documented inspection, and you get photos and plain condition notes before the quote. Financing is available for qualifying projects. Leave your details here and the team will follow up.

greeting: Hi there! I'm the SunCraft Roofing assistant - happy to help with roof inspections, repairs, replacements or maintenance questions.
hours: Hours aren't published on the SunCraft Roofing website - call 310-955-1051 or email info@suncraftroofing.com for current hours.

services.name: Roof inspections
services.description: A documented roof inspection before anything is quoted - photos of what Garrett finds, plain condition notes, and straight answers on whether you need a repair or a replacement.

services.name: Roof repair
services.description: Leak detection, flashing repair, storm damage and tile resets - proper repairs, not patches that fail in two seasons.

services.name: Roof replacement
services.description: Complete tear-off and reroofing when a roof is at the end of its life, in shingle, tile or metal.

services.name: Residential roofing
services.description: Roofing for single-family homes across the South Bay and Greater Los Angeles, including gutters.

services.name: Commercial roofing
services.description: Flat roof installation, repair, coatings and maintenance for warehouses, retail, offices, light industrial and HOA or multifamily properties.

services.name: Roof maintenance
services.description: Seasonal cleaning, sealant refresh and drain checks to keep small problems from becoming big ones.

services.name: Emergency roof repair
services.description: Storm just opened your roof up? Call 310-955-1051 - SunCraft handles emergency roof repairs.
